Decision issued on October 8, 2008, following a hearing conducted on October 2, 2008, by
Shirley J. Winsley, ViceC- hair, presiding officer for the Board ofTax Appeals (Board).
In order forthis Board to reconsider the decision set forth in the Proposed Decision, it
must be clear that thepresiding officer did not properly consider the evidence or that there was
an omission ofcertain pertinent facts or amisapplication ofthe law.
The Board reviewed the written exceptions, the Respondents' reply, the Proposed
Decision issued, and all available information and material. We conclude that the issues raised
by the Appellant were adequately addressed in the Proposed Decision, and that the evidence and
law wereproperly considered and applied. The Board finds no basis for changing the decision.
Therefore, we deny the exceptions and adopt the Proposed Decision as the Final Decision ofthis
Board.
